shift_time_check.name: shift_time_check
shift_time_check.value: ("shift"."starts_time" is null and "shift"."ends_time" is null and not "shift"."ends_next_day") or ("shift"."starts_time" is not null and "shift"."ends_time" is not null and "shift"."ends_next_day" = ("shift"."ends_time" <= "shift"."starts_time"))

task_when_check.name: task_when_check
task_when_check.value: ("task"."when_kind" = 'date' and "task"."ends_on" is null) or ("task"."when_kind" = 'range' and "task"."ends_on" is not null and "task"."ends_on" >= "task"."starts_on")
